english.title: Exceed the speed limit within Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE / AREA..) with Luton Airport at a speed exceeding

(A)_[fifteen miles per hour in the area between Stands 1 to 9L]_
(B)_[twenty miles per hour in a part of the airside area other than Stands 1 to 9L]_
(C)_[twenty miles per hour in an area designated by a notice]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.3 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
